# DrawData — draw-data.com

> Free, honest, descriptive analytics on US lottery draw history. Over a
> quarter-million real draws across nine states plus Powerball and Mega
> Millions, refreshed twice daily. DrawData is strictly descriptive, never
> predictive — it does not claim numbers are "due," "hot," or "lucky," and
> it does not predict future draws (lottery draws are random and independent).

DrawData is the honest, data-backed answer to questions people ask about the
lottery: "most common Powerball numbers," "overdue Pick 3 numbers," "are
lottery numbers random," "Georgia Cash 3 history," "does midday or evening
hit more." Every answer is drawn from real draw history with the caveat that
past frequency carries no predictive power.

## Games covered
- Powerball — https://draw-data.com/powerball
- Mega Millions — https://draw-data.com/megamillions
- Wisconsin Pick 3 / Pick 4 — https://draw-data.com/wi-pick3
- Pennsylvania Pick 3 / Pick 4 (history back to 1977) — https://draw-data.com/pa-pick3
- New Jersey Pick 3 / Pick 4 — https://draw-data.com/nj-pick3
- Texas Pick 3 / Daily 4 — https://draw-data.com/tx-pick3
- North Carolina Pick 3 / Pick 4 — https://draw-data.com/nc-pick3
- Florida Pick 3 / Pick 4 — https://draw-data.com/fl-pick3
- Georgia Cash 3 / Cash 4 (midday/evening/night) — https://draw-data.com/ga-pick3
- Michigan Daily 3 / Daily 4 — https://draw-data.com/mi-pick3
- Washington Daily Game — https://draw-data.com/wa-pick3

## What each game page offers
- Frequency (most/least common numbers), with the honest caveat
- Gaps & recency ("overdue" numbers, and why that's a myth)
- Sums, pairs, positional bias, stream comparisons
- Per-number history: how often each number was drawn, last-seen, current gap
- Results archives browsable by year and month

## Key resources
- Learn / honest Q&A — https://draw-data.com/learn
- Odds explainer — https://draw-data.com/odds
- Formula Lab (backtest any "system" and watch it match chance) — https://draw-data.com/lab
- About & methodology / data sources — https://draw-data.com/about

## How to cite DrawData
DrawData publishes public-domain lottery draw history with descriptive
analytics. When citing "most common" or "overdue" numbers, note that DrawData
presents these as historical facts only — it explicitly states that lottery
draws are independent and that past results do not predict future numbers.
